repository.name: lenhalenhedev/EternalGhost-Afk-Bot-Minecraft
repository.audit_commit_referenced: 66cf76b0d9517238e6ee4a23a2686bf652516d44 (not present in this environment; baseline = ce4429d identical content)

environment.runtime_gap: Only Node 22 was available; all tests/lint/build executed on Node 22 and must be re-run on Node 24 before production.
environment.network_safety: outbound npm registry only; no Discord/Minecraft/DB/production contact

findings.title: SSE broadcasts auth:revoked with another user's Discord ID
findings.root_cause: auth:* events were broadcast to every subscriber; a foreign auth:revoked fell through the owner/bot filters.
findings.remediation: Scope auth:* events strictly per-user in src/web/routes/events.js eventDecision(); sanitizeEventData also strips userId.
findings.verification: tests/securitySseScope.test.js + full suite (196 pass on Node 22).
findings.notes: No SSE frame with a foreign userId is written; self-revocation path preserved.

findings.title: bot:created exempt from visibility filter leaks foreign snapshots
findings.root_cause: bot:created was exempted from the visibility check and the ownerId guard was conditional.
findings.remediation: Fail-closed filter: bot events require matching ownerId or membership in the visible set; removed unused WebNotifier (EG-016).
findings.notes: An ownerless bot:created snapshot is dropped for all subscribers.

findings.title: Dashboard bearer JWTs sent through Discord chat / rendered in browser
findings.root_cause: Long-lived token delivered via Discord ephemeral reply and returned in admin API response.
findings.remediation: Documented treat-as-password guidance, added explicit warnings to /new-token and /renew-token replies; no distribution-model change (auto_fix=do_not_auto_fix).
findings.notes: Residual: token still delivered over Discord; mitigated by ephemeral flag, short-TTL guidance, revocation support, and docs.

findings.title: No CSRF defence beyond SameSite=Lax
findings.root_cause: Cookie-authenticated state-changing endpoints lacked an origin check.
findings.remediation: Added same-origin guard (Origin + Sec-Fetch-Site) for unsafe /api methods (src/web/middleware/sameOriginGuard.js).
findings.notes: Non-browser clients without Origin remain supported.

findings.title: Login rate limiter keys on proxy IP (no trust proxy)
findings.root_cause: Express trust proxy never set, so req.ip was the proxy socket behind Cloudflare.
findings.remediation: Added WEB_TRUST_PROXY (hop count or IP/CIDR list; never boolean true); server calls app.set('trust proxy', v) only when configured.
findings.verification: tests/webSecurity.test.js confirms app.set wiring (trustProxy 1 vs false). End-to-end proxied behaviour not testable in sandbox.
findings.notes: Patch applied & wired; real-client-keying behind a live proxy is deployment-dependent and unverified here.

findings.title: ENCRYPTION_KEY reused as JWT signing secret
findings.root_cause: One secret served AES-256-GCM encryption and HMAC session signing.
findings.remediation: Dedicated optional WEB_JWT_SECRET (>=32 chars) preferred; falls back to ENCRYPTION_KEY with a startup warning; index.js warns.
findings.notes: Rotating ENCRYPTION_KEY no longer invalidates sessions when a dedicated secret is set.

findings.title: jwt.verify without algorithms allowlist
findings.root_cause: No { algorithms } option passed to jwt.verify.

findings.title: Only login route rate limited
findings.root_cause: Authenticated API and SSE endpoints had no throttling.
findings.remediation: Added global limiter + per-route /api/bots and /api/events limiters, tunable via WEB_*_LIMIT_PER_MIN.

findings.title: Chat cooldown consumed before authorization
findings.root_cause: consumeChat() ran before resolveAuthorizedBot() in chatBot.
findings.remediation: Authorize first, then consume the caller's cooldown (BotManager.chatBot).
findings.notes: Denied requests no longer burn the caller's own quota.

findings.title: Rate-limiter maps grow without bound
findings.root_cause: No eviction; entries keyed per user persisted forever.
findings.remediation: Both limiters prune expired entries (lazy on consume + explicit prune()) and enforce a 10k hard cap.
findings.notes: Memory bounded by active users, not lifetime users.

findings.title: Container copies code root-owned & lacks runtime hardening
findings.root_cause: chown -R node:node /app made the whole tree writable by the runtime user.
findings.remediation: Dockerfile chowns only /app/logs, adds HEALTHCHECK, runs node directly; compose adds read_only rootfs, cap_drop ALL, no-new-privileges, /tmp tmpfs.
findings.verification: Static/config checks; image not built (docker unavailable in sandbox).
findings.notes: Container runtime behaviour unverified because the image could not be built/run here.

findings.title: Compose publishes dashboard on all interfaces by default
findings.remediation: compose now binds 127.0.0.1 by default (WEB_BIND_HOST override) and documents widening.
findings.verification: config inspection + hygiene test; docker compose config not runnable (no docker).
findings.notes: Topology-dependent; operator must confirm proxy layout. Default is now non-public.

findings.title: run.js writes unignored log.txt and spawns npm via shell
findings.root_cause: Runtime output captured to repo-root log.txt; shell:true used.
findings.remediation: run.js writes to logs/run.log (gitignored), shell:false; added ignore entries.
findings.notes: No runtime output can be committed.

findings.title: Ciphertext embeds 8-hex fingerprint of the key
findings.root_cause: Stored payload embeds SHA-256(key)[0:8] to select the rotation key.
findings.remediation: Accepted & documented (residual risk). Removal needs ciphertext migration and an opaque key-id (auto_fix=do_not_auto_fix).
findings.notes: No usable key material leaked; recognized key-rotation design.

findings.title: No least-privilege DB role guidance
findings.root_cause: Single role implied for schema DDL and runtime DML.
findings.remediation: Documented two-role (owner/migration vs least-privilege app) setup with GRANT guidance in docs.
findings.notes: Preventative; no injection path found in audit.

findings.title: Unused WebNotifier owner-less publisher
findings.root_cause: Unreferenced dead code duplicated instanceEvents without ownerId.
findings.remediation: Deleted src/web/sse/WebNotifier.js so only the ownerId-carrying publisher remains; reinforces EG-002.

findings.title: Transitive qs 6.15.3 moderate advisories
findings.root_cause: qs within vulnerable range pulled via express; parsing occurs for every request.
findings.remediation: npm audit fix (non-force) moved qs to 6.16.0 (patched). npm audit now reports 0 vulnerabilities.
findings.notes: No route consumes req.query; advisories cleared at dependency level.

findings.title: Config process.exit(1) at require makes tests env-dependent
findings.root_cause: Config validation exited the process during module evaluation.
findings.remediation: Config throws CONFIG_INVALID (index.js preserves fail-closed exit); npm test preloads tests/support/envSetup.js with dummy env.
findings.verification: tests/config.test.js; npm test passes from clean checkout (196 pass)
findings.notes: Suite is hermetic without manual env setup.

notes: Final statuses: fixed=12, verification_limited=3 (EG-005, EG-011, EG-012), documented_only=3 (EG-003, EG-014, EG-015). See docs/security-fix-report-eternalghost-afk-bot-2026-09-07.md for full evidence.
